name: 海辺
description: A sunny beach in summer. Two children are kneeling on the sand and building a sandcastle with a red flag. One of them is digging with a yellow shovel, and a red bucket is next to them. A seagull is flying away with a sandwich in its beak, and a woman in a pink dress is surprised and reaching up next to a checkered picnic blanket with a basket. A man is sleeping on a striped towel under a red and white beach umbrella with a straw hat on his face. A boy is floating in the sea with a red and white float ring. There is a small sailboat on the sea, two palm trees, a crab and rocks near the water, a surfboard standing in the sand, a beach ball, a cooler, and footprints in the sand.

name: カフェ
description: Inside a cozy cafe with a wooden floor. A waiter in a black apron is walking with a tray of two cups of coffee. A man in a blue shirt has knocked over his coffee cup, and the coffee is spilling off the table onto the floor. He is raising his hand in surprise. A woman in a yellow sweater is typing on a laptop at a table by the window, and a small dog is sleeping under her table. A girl in a red dress is eating a piece of strawberry cake, and her mother is taking a picture of the cake with her phone. Behind the counter, a barista in a green apron is making coffee with an espresso machine. On the counter there is a glass case with cakes and a cash register. There is a chalkboard menu on the wall, three lamps hanging from a beam, big windows with plants, a coat rack, and an empty table with flowers.

name: 雨のバス停
description: A shopping street on a rainy day. A woman in a cream coat is waiting at the bus stop under a blue umbrella. A girl without an umbrella is running toward the bus stop with her bag over her head. A red car is driving through a big puddle and splashing water onto the sidewalk. A boy in a yellow raincoat and green boots is jumping into a puddle. An old man is sitting on the bench in the bus shelter and reading a newspaper. A gray cat is sitting on the windowsill of the bakery, staying dry under the awning. There is a bakery with a red and white striped awning and bread in the window, a flower shop with a green awning and buckets of flowers in front, a red mailbox, and a street lamp.
